headline: State officials ask WV Supreme Court for more time on school funding lawsuit, cite upcoming session
summary: West Virginia's Attorney General asks state Supreme Court to delay hearing on inadequate school funding lawsuit until April 2027, allowing legislature time to revise the outdated school funding formula during the next 60-Day session starting January 2027.

headline: A wastewaster manager faces 3 years in prison for hiding 3 years of E. coli contamination from SC
summary: A senior wastewater manager in South Carolina pleaded guilty to federal Clean Water Act violations for concealing E. coli contamination in the Little Saluda River, leading to fish kills and potential public health risks. He faces up to three years in prison and fines up to $50,000 per violation. This incident, along with a recent sewage spill into Lake Wylie, raises concerns about the state's environmental regulations and public health safety.

headline: Vermont has assigned its $195 million in federal rural health dollars. Here’s where it’s going.
summary: Vermont allocated $195M in federal Rural Health Transformation funds in 10 months, with year one focusing on rural healthcare infrastructure, workforce, and service coordination. The state aims to regionalize care, with major investments in facility upgrades and shared service efforts. The second phase begins with ongoing monitoring and upcoming awards.

headline: Pre-Election Day poll predicts Democratic sweep in Rhode Island
summary: A University of New Hampshire poll shows Rhode Island's gubernatorial candidate Helena Buonanno Foulkes has a 21-point lead over independent Ken Block, while Democratic Lt. Gov. Sabina Matos has a 15-point lead over Republican John Loughlin. Foulkes' favorability rating has improved since September, but neither she nor Block has high favorability ratings.

headline: Outside Michigan ICE detention center, activists mourn the dead and demand change
summary: On Nov. 1, 2026, around 100 people gathered outside North Lake Processing Center in Baldwin, Michigan, for a Day of the Dead ceremony to honor individuals who died in ICE custody or due to immigration enforcement. The event, organized by several immigrant rights advocacy groups, aimed to amplify the names of the deceased, stand in solidarity with detainees, and protest immigration policies.

headline: Your Massachusetts midterm rundown
summary: The Massachusetts midterm elections in 2026 are expected to maintain Democratic majorities, with Governor Healey and Senator Markey favored for re-election despite residents' cost-of-living concerns. Nine ballot questions, including tax policy and marijuana legalization, will be decided by voters. Political analysts discuss potential Democratic victories nationally and strategies for Massachusetts Republicans to become competitive again.

headline: Virginia governor pledges overhaul of outdated K-12 school funding formula
summary: Virginia Gov. Abigail Spanberger has committed to reforming the state's outdated K-12 funding formula within her current term, aiming to better meet students' needs and reduce local government expenses. The process, expected to take up to 24 months, will involve hiring an expert to study a new funding mechanism and input from education leaders. The governor hopes to complete this before her term ends in 2029.

headline: Commentary: Survey finds fear, desire for reset in Washington. Will Trump accept the results?
summary: A Virginia Mercury reader poll found Virginians' top concerns heading into midterm elections are rising living costs and fears about democratic norms. Over 1.4 million Virginians had voted early as of Oct 17, surpassing 2022's early voting total.
